auth-form

sections · 0.5.0 · aj-s-auth-form

The content column of every account screen: sign in, create account, forgot and reset password, and the account and data states. A heading, an optional line of copy, an optional form of labelled fields (the password field with its show control, a note and an error line), and a row of actions. On the plain-paper spread it is the opaque card with soft shadows; on an account sheet it is a 440px column.
